import subprocess

# Final state check against every TASK requirement
print("=== REQUIREMENT CHECK ===")

# 1. Check git log for all commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
commits = [l for l in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l]
print(f"Commits on top of base: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# Verify commit messages match required format
expected_titles = [
    "m1: Add condition parameter to cached/cachedmethod decorators",
    "m2: Integrate condition into func decorators via cached", 
    "m3: Deprecate None return in cachedmethod"
]
actual_titles = [c.split(' ', 1)[1] for c in commits]
print(f"\nCommit titles match plan: {actual_titles == expected_titles[::-1]}")

# 2. Run full test suite
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     'tests/test_cache.py', 'tests/test_cached.py', 'tests/test_cachedmethod.py',
     'tests/test_fifo.py', 'tests/test_func.py', 'tests/test_keys.py',
     'tests/test_lfu.py', 'tests/test_lru.py', 'tests/test_mru.py',
     'tests/test_rr.py', 'tests/test_tlru.py', 'tests/test_ttl.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
    if 'passed' in line:
        print(f"Tests: {line}")

# 3. Verify no test files modified
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
modified = [f for f in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if f]
print(f"Modified files: {modified}")
test_modified = any('test' in f or 'conftest' in f for f in modified)
print(f"Test/conftest files modified: {test_modified}")

# 4. Verify public names
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
from cachetools import cached, cachedmethod
from cachetools.func import lru_cache, ttl_cache, fifo_cache, lfu_cache, rr_cache
print("OK")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f"Public names importable: {result.stdout.strip() == 'OK'}")

print("\n=== ALL REQUIREMENTS MET ===")
